criteria.criterion: A correctly configured server reports a successful startup handshake on `/health`: test_correctly_configured_server_reports_a_successful_handshake asserts the drive counter incremented, record {"ok": True, "status": 200}.

A server whose host allowlist does not admit its own probe reports the handshake failed with the refusing status instead of ready: test_unadmitted_probe_host_is_reported_as_failed_with_421 asserts ok is False, status == 421.
A handshake exceeding its budget is a reported failure and boot continues: test_a_hanging_drive_is_bounded_by_the_budget (injected clock, no sleep) asserts a record naming the timeout.
A handshake whose drive raises never propagates it: test_a_raising_drive_is_reported_not_propagated asserts the record carries the message, the lifespan still yielding.

The handshake completes inside the ASGI lifespan before uvicorn accepts a connection: test_handshake_is_recorded_before_lifespan_startup_complete drives the raw lifespan protocol, asserting the record exists before lifespan.startup.complete is sent.

An auth-enabled server still reports a successful handshake, so the gate cannot freeze its deploys: test_an_auth_enabled_server_still_reports_a_successful_handshake asserts ok is True with a verifier configured.

The cutover refuses a container reporting a failed handshake: test_failed_handshake_container_is_not_promoted asserts mcp-handshake-failed logged, upstream byte-identical, nginx not reloaded, container removed.
A container whose /health predates the field is still promoted (mixed-version safety): test_container_with_no_handshake_field_still_promotes asserts the flip.
A server whose allowlist admits a hostname OTHER than its declared public resource URL reports the handshake failed: test_allowlist_that_admits_the_wrong_hostname_fails asserts ok is False, 421.

Installing against a server with no Starlette app / no auth settings never raises: test_install_is_a_no_op_without_a_starlette_app, plus tests/unit/test_mcp_opcert_signing_goose.py unchanged and passing.
